decks.notes: This deck focuses on generating a lot of value by utilizing sacrifice synergies with cards like Witch's Oven and Cauldron Familiar. It also uses graveyard recursion with cards like Badgermole Cub and Ygra, Eater of All to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay while slowly wearing down the opponent's resources. Additionally, the deck has a toolbox aspect with cards like Traverse the Ulvenwald to find key pieces when needed.

This deck focuses on using a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful creatures to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Abrupt Decay while deploying threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser to close out the game. The deck aims to control the board and grind out incremental advantages until it can overwhelm the opponent with its strong late-game threats.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful spells. By utilizing cards like Lightning Axe, Winternight Stories, and Proft's Eidetic Memory to control the board and deal direct damage, while deploying creatures like Marauding Mako and Vivi Ornitier to apply pressure, the deck seeks to quickly finish off the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Jadzi, Steward of Fate provide additional value and card advantage to maintain momentum. By balancing aggression and control, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost spells and creatures to deal direct damage to the opponent quickly and efficiently. By combining prowess triggers from spells like Burst Lightning and Flow State with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, the deck aims to pressure the opponent and end the game as fast as possible. The inclusion of cards like Reckless Rage and Monstrous Rage allows for removal and additional damage, while the mana base supports the deck's aggressive playstyle. Overall, the deck aims to win through aggressive early game plays and efficient spell-based damage.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with elemental synergy and ramping up mana to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of powerful creatures. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional value and support for the elemental creatures in the deck. By efficiently ramping up mana and playing high-impact creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation, the deck aims to put continuous pressure on the opponent and win through aggressive creature-based strategies. It also includes cards for protection and disruption, such as Voice of Resurgence and Boseiju, Who Endures, to maintain control of the game.

This deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo, which allows for powerful interactions and game-winning plays. By utilizing cards such as Bitter Triumph, Thoughtseize, and Cache Grab to control the game, while ramping and setting up the combo pieces like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with an army of tokens and powerful creatures. With a mix of removal, card draw, and efficient creatures, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and take over the game with its powerful synergies.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with quick and efficient spells and creatures in order to deal damage quickly. It combines spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy. The deck also includes card draw and mana fixing to ensure consistent performance. By utilizing a mix of burn spells, creatures, and card advantage, this deck aims to pressure the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to react.

The main concept of the deck is to use cheap, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage to quickly put pressure on the opponent. By utilizing spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to remove threats and push damage through, the deck aims to finish the game quickly. Multiversal Passage and Riverpyre Verge provide additional mana fixing and flexibility in casting spells. The deck also includes cards like Stormchaser's Talent and Emberheart Challenger to help maintain board presence and increase the damage output. Overall, the deck is focused on aggressive play and finishing the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on using control elements and board wipes to maintain dominance over the game. It utilizes cards like Dovin's Veto and Supreme Verdict to negate threats and clear the board. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria provides card advantage and disruption, while the Companion Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for additional value with its blinking ability. The mana base is built to support the deck's control game plan, with a mixture of dual lands and utility lands. Overall, the deck is designed to outmaneuver opponents and control the pace of the game.

This deck revolves around combining the abilities of Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a powerful synergy. It utilizes cards like Monument to Endurance and Fleeting Spirit to support this combo, while also including removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse for control. The deck aims to dominate the battlefield with its creatures and enchantments, making it difficult for the opponent to keep up. By efficiently managing resources and setting up the Greasefang-Parhelion combo, this deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on a fast-paced and aggressive strategy, utilizing a combination of evasive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By efficiently controlling the board with cards like Floodpits Drowner and Spyglass Siren, while also applying pressure with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and disruptive hand disruption effects like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong offense.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells. The deck aims to swarm the board with aggressive creatures like Novice Inspectors and Venerated Loxodons, while using Gleeful Demolition and Portable Hole to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Knight-Errant of Eos and Warden of the Inner Sky helps maintain card advantage and board presence. The deck's mana base ensures a consistent flow of white and red mana to support its aggressive game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to build up a strong board presence through devotion to green mana and aggressive creatures. By playing cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, you can quickly ramp up your mana production to play powerful creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Craterhoof Behemoth. Cards like Spider Manifestation and Vastlands Scavenger provide additional threats, while Collected Company allows you to dig for more creatures. Castle Garenbrig and Ba Sing Se provide additional mana sources to keep the pressure on your opponent.

This deck focuses on removing threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan while establishing a controlling board presence. It utilizes a mix of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures to maintain control of the game. The main strategy is to disrupt the opponent's resources and win through attrition by out valuing them with efficient removal and resilient threats. The deck also includes a few utility lands to support its game plan and ensure a consistent mana base for casting its spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Greasefang Parhelion combo to generate a powerful board presence and overwhelm opponents. The key strategy involves supporting the combo pieces with utility cards such as Thoughtseize for disruption and Collective Brutality for flexibility. The deck includes a mix of lands to ensure consistency in mana production, as well as a variety of creature and spell options to maintain control of the board and apply pressure to the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and secure victory through overwhelming force.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's plans and control the game through counter spells, board wipes, and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Dovin's Veto, Supreme Verdict, Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, and No More Lies, you can effectively manage the board and hand advantage. Additionally, cards like March of Otherworldly Light and Emeritus of Ideation provide additional value and card draw to help maintain control of the game. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and slowly grind them out until you can secure the win.
